descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a QA Engineer to support the Product Owners in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of AI-enabled ITSM solutions developed using Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio.
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Product Owners to review user stories, acceptance criteria, and business requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential testing risks early in the development process.
Define, maintain, and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and regression test suites covering Power Apps, Power Automate workflows and Dataverse components.
Validate Copilot Studio agents and conversational experiences, including conversation flows, intent recognition, response accuracy, grounding, fallback mechanisms and responsible AI controls.
Perform end-to-end testing of ITSM processes, including Incident, Service Request, Change, and Knowledge Management, ensuring seamless integration across systems, workflows, and notifications.
Develop and maintain automated test scenarios for repetitive and business-critical processes, covering UI, API, and regression testing.
Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects in Jira, collaborating with development teams to ensure timely resolution and validating implemented fixes.
Monitor and report quality metrics, providing clear insights into test coverage, defect trends, and overall solution quality.
 Required Skills & Experience:
3–6 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including at least 1–2 years working with Microsoft Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate)
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio and quality assurance practices for conversational AI or Generative AI solutions.
Good understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and platforms, such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar solutions.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Power Apps Test Engine, Playwright, Selenium, or Postman for API testing.
Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, using Jira for defect tracking and test management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into effective test scenarios.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Additional experience on Power Apps alongside QA skills would be ideal.
